text: Third graphics component now has real static-font shaping/FreeType coverage and immutable shared glyph data, with exact run recording and retained font-byte inspection. Local full JVM/Native tests plus 7 artifact-dependent native font tests pass. See docs/evidence/graphics/2026-10-27-text-native.md and text-native/README.md. Complete paragraph/fallback/editing geometry, GPU preparation/atlas and broader graphics qualification remain open. No external renderer adopted and no existing native pause gate closed.
